title: NO HUM UNDER THE RAID
why: His note of 2026-10-12: random hums as ambience do not sound good. Three tones ran under every raid: two low sine drones at 54 and 81.5 Hz in the ambient bed (their pitch rose as something closed on you) and a 36 Hz dread tone that swelled as the Warden came near. On top of them, v24.73 gave every machine hunting you out of sight its own running voice: a servo whine, a hydraulic throb, a drone tone, a dish sweep, a growl, a tread rumble. All of those tones are removed. What stays is not a tone: the room-tone noise under the raid (it still opens up and swells as a machine closes in), the rain, and every machine one-shot (servo, skitter, hydraulics, dish, footsteps, alarms, the lock-on beep). Nothing else in the file held a looping tone in a raid: every other oscillator is a one-shot with its own stop, and the Undercroft music plays only on the menus.
now: The low hums under the raid are gone: no drones, no dread tone and no running machine voices, only the room noise, rain and the machine cues.
